chunks: On their faces you will see the glow of beatitude.
ai.seo_question: What does the 'glow of beatitude' on the faces of the righteous signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this 'radiance of bliss' (nadrat al-na'im) is often interpreted as a physical manifestation of the inner light of faith (nur al-iman) and the proximity to the Ahl al-Bayt, distinguishing the righteous from those whose faces darken in sorrow. This visible sign serves as a testament to their spiritual purity and the tangible reality of divine grace in the afterlife, reinforcing the connection between inner belief and outer manifestation.
